scenes.title: OTS — yeti prompts Scout in class
scenes.description: Camera arcs from beside the yeti to directly behind him in the lecture hall; his phone fills center frame, Scout orb glowing.
scenes.vo: Yeti (whispering): “Find me hiring managers at Doogle.”
scenes.notes: Animate via seedance start_image. Composite scene-2 promo clip onto the phone screen in Remotion.

scenes.title: Screen insert — Scout UI (promo clip)
scenes.description: What plays on the phone: voice command → hiring-manager list → 'Ready to send — 5 emails' → send.
scenes.notes: Clip = promo-saas-v2 9.5–23.0s. Says J.P. Morgan — either keep, or re-skin to Doogle with the src/components/mock/ UI in Remotion.

scenes.title: Zoom in — Scout responds
scenes.description: Fast push-in on the screen as Scout's chat bubble types out.
scenes.notes: Text already rendered in the still; can re-render crisp via Remotion mock if animated.

scenes.title: Scout — emailing hiring managers
scenes.description: Bubble updates; five avatar dots fill along a progress line; send icon starts to glow.

scenes.title: Whip-zoom into the send icon
scenes.description: Camera dives into the glowing paper-plane icon until it fills frame — transition out of the UI world.
scenes.notes: Whoosh SFX; match-cut to mail flight.

scenes.title: Mail streaks across the city
scenes.description: Light-envelope rockets over sunlit downtown LA, heavy motion blur — the 'gets a little blurry' beat. Bright midday.
scenes.notes: Animate with seedance; keep trail continuous into next shot.

scenes.title: Lands on a professional's desktop
scenes.description: Envelope of light lands in the hiring manager's monitor with a soft ripple; she leans in. Sunlit office, LA towers outside.

scenes.title: Zoom out — LA skyline, mail into buildings
scenes.description: Pull back out of the office into a wide daytime aerial of the LA skyline; blue mail-trails arc down from the sky into different towers, pulsing where they enter.
scenes.notes: Replaced the US-map beat per Nick — real daytime skyline instead of stylized map.

scenes.title: One tower lights up green
scenes.description: Same aerial: the trails fade, one tower pulses green — a reply. Camera dives toward it.
scenes.notes: Green = reply/positive through the rest of the sequence.

scenes.title: Hiring manager replies
scenes.description: Inside that tower: the same hiring manager types a reply, green-tinted compose window glowing on her screen. Daytime.
scenes.notes: Same woman/office as s07 (chained as image reference).

scenes.title: Reply travels back to campus
scenes.description: Green envelope arcs across the midday sky from downtown LA back toward the brick campus.

scenes.title: Yeti gets the interview
scenes.description: Back in class: popup slides in, yeti reads it wide-eyed and grins.
scenes.vo: Email popup: “Hi Rylan — thank you for reaching out. We'd be glad to set up an interview for the Product Management role at Doogle. Would Thursday afternoon work? — Sarah, Doogle Recruiting”
scenes.notes: Render the email card as a Remotion mock popup for legibility. REGEN CANDIDATE: yeti face slightly off canonical (heavier muzzle).
